format: lightsuffer-ios CPU auto-exposure common fixture v1

notes.float_format: all floating point values are rounded to 7 significant digits
notes.preview: ResizingService.small_preview(image) with the default max_size=256 and order=0. The input long edge is 320, so the linear and encoded previews are both downsampled. Their complete upstream arrays are included for sampling diagnostics.
notes.unknown_method: 'not_a_metering_method' intentionally exercises the upstream unknown-method fallback (exposure=1, EV=0).

linear_prophoto.description: 320 x 240 deterministic bright centre, dark edges and colour gradients

srgb_encoded.description: the linear image clipped to [0, 1] and encoded with the sRGB inverse EOTF
